split.method: selected classified plate faces separated from char1; boundary vertices duplicated by Blender mesh separation

belt_measurement.method: median z of classified plate-island vertices in the central pelvis envelope

heat_binding.heat_target: I04 soft body alone after metal face separation

blue_velvet.threshold: B > 1.20 R, B > 1.20 G, face metallic < 0.35
blue_velvet.decision: at least half of a vertex's UV-loop texel samples satisfy the threshold

soft_overrides.front_slit_policy: permitted leg influence set to 0%; Hips-only selected to prevent tearing

known_gaps: zero phys_* weights / no cloth secondary motion
skirt-leg clipping is allowed in I04
